description: eWAVE (Kortmann, Lunkenheimer & Ehret 2020) example sentences from 53 varieties of English, joined from cldf/examples.csv and cldf/languages.csv. Label is the full variety name (e.g. 'Scottish English'). Varieties with fewer than 2 examples are dropped in the loader (no-op on the v3.0.1 release). Coverage is uneven: 29-196 examples per variety, median 71, ~4.2k records total.
